changes: Added a universal CANONICAL_RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP that reads the live canonical Project Leader plugin manifest and Skill contract before substantive routing whenever GitHub read access is available.

Added RUNTIME_SYNC_STALE and RUNTIME_CANONICAL_OVERRIDE_ACTIVE so a stale loaded ChatGPT Skill copy yields immediately to the live canonical contract for the current invocation instead of asking the Owner to resync, reinstall or wait for marketplace propagation.
Kept bare @Project Leader activation brief after the silent bootstrap and retained the installed Skill as a safe fallback when canonical GitHub is temporarily unreadable.
Explicitly avoided marketplace pluginId migration because the Owner does not want to preserve the legacy plugin identity.
Bumped Project Leader package version from 0.6.3 to 0.6.4 and added CI/regression/smoke coverage.
